nodes.description: State variable holding the CarbonCoin contract instance used for balance, supply and reward migration calls.
State variable holding the Argu contract instance used for reward cycle, claim date and exclusion checks.
Hardcoded USDT token address used to build the IERC20 usdt instance.
Public address of the uniswap pair, cached from cbc.uniswapV2Pair().
Accumulated total of rewards already claimed, incremented with arithmetic add.
IERC20 interface bound to the USDT address used for pool balance queries.
Empty constructor of ClaimRewards.
Owner-only setter that wires the Argu and CarbonCoin contracts and caches the uniswap pair.
View helper returning the USDT balance held by the CarbonCoin contract.
View helper returning the accumulated _claimTotal.
View helper delegating to argu.getRewardCycleBlock().
View helper delegating to argu.getNextAvailableClaimDate(addr).
View helper delegating to argu.isExcludedFromReward(addr).
Fallback receive function accepting plain ETH transfers.
Main claim entry point: validates eligibility, computes reward, calls external migrateRewardToken, resets claim date and updates _claimTotal.
View that computes the caller's pending USDT reward from supply and pool data.
Pure internal arithmetic computing usdtReward from balance, pool and supply.
View computing reward for an arbitrary address, gated by argu.canInvokeMe(msg.sender).
Untrusted caller address used for eligibility checks, reward lookup and access control.
Block timestamp compared against the next available claim date.
External state-changing call cbc.migrateRewardToken(msg.sender, usdtAmount) executed before the claim date is updated.
External state-changing call argu.setNextAvailableClaimDate(...) into a caller-controlled contract.
Unchecked-style mul/div arithmetic in _CalculateReward that can overflow or divide by zero when cTotalSupply is zero.
Chained subtraction computing circulating supply, vulnerable to underflow if the subtrahends exceed the total supply.
Arithmetic add updating _claimTotal with the computed usdtAmount.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as recipient in the claim requires and in migrateRewardToken.
msg.sender balance and exclusion state drive the reward computation.
msg.sender is checked through argu.canInvokeMe as the only authorization for this view.
block.timestamp is compared with getNextAvailableClaimDate, creating a timestamp dependency.
_argu parameter is stored into the argu state variable.
_cbc parameter is stored into the cbc state variable.
uniswapV2Pair is cached from cbc.uniswapV2Pair().
The hardcoded _usdt address initializes the usdt IERC20 instance.
argu.isExcludedFromReward is queried inside checkReward.
cbc.totalSupply and cbc.balanceOf feed the circulating supply computation.
usdt.balanceOf(address(cbc)) supplies the pool size to checkReward.
argu.isExcludedFromReward and canInvokeMe are queried inside checkRewardForExactAddr.
cbc supply and balance getters feed the circulating supply computation in checkRewardForExactAddr.
usdt.balanceOf(address(cbc)) supplies the pool size to checkRewardForExactAddr.
The addr parameter selects whose balance is used in the reward calculation.
addr is forwarded to argu.getNextAvailableClaimDate(addr).
addr is forwarded to argu.isExcludedFromReward(addr).
The reward returned by checkReward is assigned to usdtAmount in ClaimReward.
Local usdtAmount is populated from checkReward()'s return value.
usdtAmount is passed into the external cbc.migrateRewardToken call.
usdtAmount is added into the accumulated _claimTotal.
The arithmetic add writes the new value into the _claimTotal state variable.
getTotalClaimedRewards returns the _claimTotal state variable.
The chained subtraction produces the local circulating supply used in checkReward.
Local cTotalSupply is passed as the supply argument to _CalculateReward from checkReward.
The local multiplier constant is used inside the reward arithmetic.
currentBalance participates in the reward multiplication.
currentUsdtPool participates in the reward multiplication.
cTotalSupply is the divisor of the reward arithmetic.
The mul/div arithmetic produces the local usdtReward value.
usdtReward is the value returned by _CalculateReward.
_CalculateReward result flows back to checkReward.
_CalculateReward result flows back to checkRewardForExactAddr.
Local cTotalSupply is computed inside checkRewardForExactAddr.
ClaimReward invokes checkReward().
ClaimReward executes the external cbc.migrateRewardToken call.
ClaimReward executes the external argu.setNextAvailableClaimDate call.
ClaimReward performs the _claimTotal add after the external calls.
setArgus is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
checkReward calls _CalculateReward.
checkRewardForExactAddr calls _CalculateReward.
The external cbc.migrateRewardToken call happens before the claim date and _claimTotal are updated, allowing re-entrant ClaimReward.
The external argu.setNextAvailableClaimDate call into an owner-set contract can re-enter ClaimReward before accounting is finalized.
Only the owner-controlled modifier path may write the argu contract reference.
